colleague — a swappable coder-agent harness. One runtime, many minds.

positional arguments:
  {whoami,quickstart,learn,learn-from,explain,overview,doctor,clean,cli,work,drive,plan,promote,backends,wheels,feedback,flight,commands,hooks,agents,skills,roles,strive,telemetry,lobes,organs,coherence,experiment,config,session,tui,mcp}
    whoami              Report nick, version, mesh backend, and the live work
                        engine + model.
    quickstart          Guided first-run walkthrough for new users (start
                        here).
    learn               Print a structured self-teaching prompt for agent
                        consumers.
    learn-from          Learn skills from a peer agent (e.g. claude) into
                        .colleague/skills/ (see 'colleague explain learn-
                        from').
    explain             Print markdown docs for a noun/verb path. Supports
                        --json.
    overview            Read-only descriptive snapshot of the agent (identity,
                        verbs, artifacts).
    doctor              Check configuration readiness (identity, provider,
                        usage, engines, otel, environment).
    clean               Reap stale/corrupt colleague/* branches + orphaned
                        .colleague/ artifacts left by a crashed work item (see
                        'colleague explain clean').
    cli                 CLI-surface introspection (see 'colleague cli
                        overview').
    work                Work toward a goal: act autonomously on a request or
                        instruction through a coder backend, then hand off the
                        result.
    drive               Deprecated alias of 'colleague work'.
    plan                Colleague plans a complex task (see 'colleague plan
                        overview').
    promote             Graduate colleague into a resident Culture member:
                        mint identity, select channels, register, and (with
                        --serve) go live (see 'colleague explain promote').
    backends            Discover installed backend plugins (see 'colleague
                        backends overview').
    wheels              Deprecated alias of 'colleague backends'.
    feedback            Grade a work item after the fact (see 'colleague
                        feedback overview').
    flight              Pilot a running work item (see 'colleague flight
                        overview').
    commands            Discover command templates (see 'colleague commands
                        overview').
    hooks               Inspect configured lifecycle hooks (see 'colleague
                        hooks overview').
    agents              Inspect layered AGENTS instruction files (see
                        'colleague agents overview').
    skills              Inspect layered skill docs (see 'colleague skills
                        overview').
    roles               Inspect the typed subagent roles (see 'colleague roles
                        overview').
    strive              Bounded-attempt hypothesis-driven iteration (see
                        'colleague strive overview').
    telemetry           Inspect the telemetry / OpenTelemetry config (see
                        'colleague telemetry overview').
    lobes               Inspect the lobes gateway state (see 'colleague lobes
                        overview').
    organs              Inspect the AI-coworker organism (see 'colleague
                        organs overview').
    coherence           On-demand coherence measurement (see 'colleague
                        coherence overview').
    experiment          Detached sloth training runs:
                        start/status/list/summarize (see 'colleague experiment
                        overview').
    config              Inspect the resolved provider configuration (see
                        'colleague config overview').
    session             Agent-native interactive cockpit: type a free-text
                        goal and it routes to work or plan on colleague's own
                        backend — no subcommand needed.
    tui                 Headless TUI inspection + JSON scenario runner (see
                        'colleague tui overview').
    mcp                 Serve colleague's operations as an MCP server (see
                        'colleague mcp overview').

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

getting started:
  colleague quickstart       guided first-run walkthrough — start here
  colleague doctor           check your configuration is ready to run
  colleague whoami           identity + the live work engine and model

working:
  colleague work <goal>      delegate a scoped repo task to a backend
  colleague session          interactive foreground palette
  colleague plan <goal>      plan a complex task (spec -> plan -> workforce)
  colleague feedback ...     grade a finished work item (the ROI loop)

inspecting:
  colleague backends list    discovered model backends (the minds)
  colleague config show      resolved provider configuration
  colleague explain <topic>  markdown docs for any noun/verb

Tip: 'colleague <verb> --help' for a verb's flags, or 'colleague explain' for
the full command catalog. runs the branch code and dispatches resume on colleague at the medium acting-seat default.
